title: Diversified and Personalized Multi-Rater Medical Image Segmentation (D-Persona)
mechanism: Stage 1 trains a Probabilistic U-Net on multi-rater labels to build a shared latent space. Stage 2 attention heads extract expert-specific prompts for personalized masks.
adaptation: Use label versions as raters: the 2021 original and 2022 revised crack/inactive masks exist for the same cells. Train on both and output the revised-style persona, so the old labels add signal instead of being discarded.
min_experiment: Arm = two-version D-Persona-style head (3 seeds) versus house PF on revised labels only. Metric: crack IoU clean-49 and relF1@2. Kill if < +0.012.
evidence: R: NPC-170 (in-house) and LIDC-IDRI; better diversity and personalized accuracy than multi-rater baselines (abstract).
prior_overlap: label version change gave +0.05 to +0.08 crack IoU, but no run trained on both versions jointly

alt_notes.adaptation: Use label version as rater: 2021 original and 2022 revised BenchmarkEL crack / inactive masks give two raters per cell. Train on both, output the revised persona; the old masks become extra signal instead of being discarded.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: two-rater (version) model, 5 seeds, revised-persona output. Baseline: house PF on revised labels only. Metric: clean-49 crack and inactive IoU. Kill if crack IoU gain < +0.012 and inactive < +0.03.
